title: Talon Chase ontology
description: Entities, value types, enumerations and evidence payloads of Talon Chase. Every object is closed. x-ref names the entity an id points at; x-sensitive marks values that must never be sent to a carrier.

Attachment.title: Attachment

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes; the file is stored under it.

Attachment.description: A file referred to by its content hash.

Attempt.title: Attempt

cc.description: Copied, e.g. the broker's rep on the third request.

queued_at_ms.description: When it was decided and queued.

Attempt.description: A request the agent decided to make. Its delivery is the outbox message.

Broker.title: Broker

name.description: Trading name, shown to carriers in every message.

chase_mailbox.description: The broker's own address that requests come from, e.g. pods@.

rep_email.description: Where packets and copied third requests go.

sms_number.description: The number texts come from; empty means no texts.

adapter.description: Where checked PODs are filed: an adapter name.

Broker.description: A freight brokerage using Talon Chase.

BrokerConfig.title: BrokerConfig

no_status_grace_ms.description: Open a chase this long after the delivery appointment if the load has no status.

sms_delay_ms.description: Text the driver this long after the first email.

third_attempt_ms.description: Third request this long after the first.

escalate_wait_ms.description: Hand to a person this long after the third request.

third_min_gap_ms.description: Shortest gap between the second and third requests.

promise_grace_ms.description: How long a carrier's promise ('will send tomorrow') pushes the next ask back.

reask_wait_ms.description: After a re-ask, wait this long before the plan continues.

quiet_start_hour.description: Carrier-local hour when quiet hours begin.

quiet_end_hour.description: Carrier-local hour when quiet hours end.

morning_hour.description: Carrier-local hour of the second request.

max_reasks.description: Re-asks for a failing document before a person decides.

date_tolerance_ms.description: How far the POD's delivery date may be from the appointment.

confidence_floor.description: Below this reading confidence (0 to 100), a person decides.

writeback_retry_backoff_ms.description: Waits between filing retries; when it runs out, the next rung is tried.

upload_link_ttl_ms.description: How long an upload link stays valid.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the broker works in; the broker screens show times in it.

send_retry_backoff_ms.description: Waits between delivery retries; when it runs out, the message fails.

BrokerConfig.description: Per-broker schedule and policy. Every value can be changed by the broker.

Carrier.title: Carrier

broker_id.description: The broker whose carrier record this is.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; quiet hours and the schedule use it.

Carrier.description: A trucking company a broker gives loads to.

Chase.title: Chase

next_action_at_ms.description: When the next step is due.

attempts_sent.description: Requests made in the schedule (first, second, third).

reasks_sent.description: Re-asks made after a failed check.

plan.description: The schedule worked out when it opened.

reply_to_contact_id.description: Who sent the last document; re-asks go to them.

kill_noted.description: A blocked step was already recorded.

Chase.description: The agent's effort to obtain one requirement.

ChaseState.title: ChaseState
ChaseState.description: Where one chase for paperwork stands.

reroute_load_id.description: The load it belongs to instead, for REROUTE.

Consent.title: Consent

seq.description: Position in this contact's consent history, from 1, in the order recorded. Decides which record is latest; times can tie and ids carry no order.

recorded_by.description: The operator who recorded it; empty when it came from the carrier or a sync.

inbound_id.description: The carrier message it came from, for a STOP reply.

Consent.description: One recorded change to whether a contact may be texted. The record with the highest ``seq`` is the contact's current state.

ConsentSource.title: ConsentSource
ConsentSource.description: Where a consent record came from.

Contact.title: Contact

verified.description: From the carrier record or approved by an operator.

email_undeliverable_at_ms.description: When mail to this address bounced for good; it is not emailed again.

Contact.description: A person at a carrier the agent may write to. Only verified contacts are used.

Document.title: Document

load_id.description: The load it is filed under.

doc_type.description: What the reader says it is.

extraction.description: What the reader read from it.

Document.description: A file received for a load.

Escalation.title: Escalation

note.description: What they did, in their words.

Escalation.description: A load handed to a person, and how they finished it.

EscalationResolution.title: EscalationResolution
EscalationResolution.description: How a person finished an escalation.

EvidenceEvent.title: EvidenceEvent

chain_id.description: The load id, or broker:<id>, or system.

seq.description: Position in the chain, from 0, no gaps.

payload.description: Details; see the payload definition for the kind.

prev_hash.description: The previous event's hash; 64 zeros for the first.

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical header and prev_hash.

EvidenceEvent.description: One entry in a load's hash chain. The payload's shape depends on the kind.

Extraction.title: Extraction

doc_type.description: What kind of document it is.

readable.description: Whether the page could be read at all.

reference_numbers.description: Load, BOL and PO numbers printed on it.

exception_notes.description: Shortage, damage or refusal noted by the receiver.

confidence.description: How sure the reader is, 0 to 100.

Extraction.description: What the reader saw on a document.

Inbound.title: Inbound

broker_id.description: The broker it was sent to.

external_id.description: Provider's message id; repeats are ignored.

classification.description: What the reply said, as labelled.

hold_reason.description: Why it was held for a person.

trusted.description: Came through a signed upload link.

Inbound.description: A message or upload from a carrier.

load_number.description: The broker's load number; the only load detail carriers see.

delivered_at_ms.description: When the TMS marked it delivered.

contact_ids.description: Carrier contacts for this load; empty means all verified contacts.

rate_cents.description: What the broker pays the carrier, in cents.

ready_to_invoice_at_ms.description: When a checked POD was filed and the load became billable.

Operator.title: Operator

broker_id.description: The broker they work for; empty for a platform operator.

Operator.description: A person who acts in Talon Chase: acknowledges, approves, switches off.

OperatorRole.title: OperatorRole
OperatorRole.description: What a person at the broker, or at TalonSight, may do.

OutboxMessage.title: OutboxMessage

purpose.description: A request to a carrier, or a packet to the broker.

idempotency_key.description: Unique; the same on every try.

next_attempt_at_ms.description: When it may next be tried.

quiet_tz.description: Carrier time zone for quiet hours; empty for the broker's own inbox.

claim_token.description: Which dispatcher holds it while SENDING.

provider_id.description: The provider's id for the delivered message.

finished_at_ms.description: When it reached SENT, FAILED or CANCELLED.

deferred_noted.description: A quiet-hours deferral was already recorded.

OutboxMessage.description: One email or text to deliver. Written in the same transaction as the decision to send it; delivered afterwards by the dispatcher, at least once.

Party.title: Party

broker_id.description: The broker whose record this is.

Party.description: A customer, shipper or consignee. Names and addresses never go to carriers.

PartyRole.title: PartyRole
PartyRole.description: A business on a load other than the broker and the carrier.

Plan.title: Plan

sms_ms.description: Driver text; 0 means none is planned.

escalate_ms.description: Hand to a person if nothing has arrived.

Plan.description: When each request in a chase is due, fixed when the chase opens.

Requirement.title: Requirement

status.description: Open, met, or resolved by a person.

met_by_document_id.description: The filed document that met it.

Requirement.description: A document a load needs before it can be billed.

RequirementStatus.title: RequirementStatus
RequirementStatus.description: Whether a load still needs a document.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: The next thing a chase will do.

WriteBack.title: WriteBack

adapter.description: Which rung of the filing ladder.

attempts.description: Adapter calls that returned an answer.

detail.description: Last error, or the pending reference.

WriteBack.description: One attempt to file a checked document in the broker's system.
